# Introduction
This project uses the Iris dataset for classification using supervised learning.

# Methods
Two models are used: Logistic Regression and Random Forest.

```{r}
data(iris)
summary(iris)
```

# Model Training
```{r}
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(nnet)

set.seed(123)
index <- createDataPartition(iris$Species, p=0.7, list=FALSE)
train <- iris[index,]
test <- iris[-index,]
```

# Results
Random Forest is expected to perform better due to nonlinear modeling.
